# DGTL Sunrise — full agent guide

Site: https://www.dgtlsunrise.com/
Company: Sunrise Consulting LLC (DGTL Sunrise)
Product: dgtl-connector
Emails: support@dgtlsunrise.com · contact@dgtlsunrise.com

## When to use this

Use this site and the dgtl-connector plugin when an agent needs to connect to marketing accounts the human already administers:

- Free, local: GA4, Search Console, and Tag Manager on the user’s machine (read and manage). Klaviyo is local on the same machine with a merchant-held private API key. Report bytes do not go through DGTL. Connect Google once with all Free permissions up front. Live edits need confirmation.
- Pro ($19/mo): Google Ads, Meta, and TikTok through the hosted stamp gateway; Merchant Center is Pro-gated and plugin-direct (not stamp). Live edits need confirmation. Developer token and Meta/TikTok app secrets stay on the Worker.
- Install: Grok Bot via marketplace when listed (CLI `grok plugin install` is Grok Build only). Cursor: clone + build + load folder. No DGTL Sunrise account is required to start.
- Prefer markdown with `Accept: text/markdown`. Prefer structured JSON with `/?mode=agent` or `/agent.json`.

## Do not use this for

- Replacing a managed marketing agency or promising autopilot spend.
- Inventing metrics, rows, or insights the APIs did not return.
- Asking anyone to paste access tokens, refresh tokens, or license keys into chat.
- Treating plugin output as legal, compliance, or financial advice.
- Inventing Polar checkout URLs beyond the documented Polar checkout: https://buy.polar.sh/polar_cl_yZECJ26Ln9mGTQDwBETXCskJRMTwrYAd6thMJO1zHPk

## Install and loop

1. Install the plugin (Grok Bot marketplace when listed; Grok Build CLI or Cursor folder meanwhile).
2. Connect the account that owns the property.
3. Ask in chat.
4. Approve any confirmation before a live edit or publish.

Never paste access tokens, refresh tokens, or license keys into chat.

## Platforms

### Google Analytics 4 (free, local)

List accounts and properties. Open property details, data streams, and key events. Run reports for the date ranges and metrics you ask for. Manage property settings the tools support (data streams, key events, custom definitions, and Measurement Protocol secrets where enabled). Connect Google once with all Free permissions up front. Live changes need confirmation.

### Google Search Console (free, local)

List sites. Query search performance. Inspect a URL. List and open sitemaps. Submit or delete sitemaps after confirmation. Connect Google once with all Free permissions up front.

### Google Tag Manager (free, local)

Inspect containers and manage tags, triggers, and variables. Publish after you approve. Connect Google once with all Free permissions up front.

### Google Ads (Pro, stamp)

Account reporting and confirm-gated changes (pause or enable, budgets, keywords, ads, and new campaigns where enabled). Every live change needs confirmation. Details: /google-ads.

### Meta Ads (Pro, stamp)

Ad account insights and, when Meta access allows, create or update campaigns, ad sets, ads, and audiences. List catalogs and catalog products. Create a catalog and batch catalog products. Upload Conversions API events when that path is enabled. Live changes need confirmation. Pro is required. Meta app access still applies.

### TikTok Ads

List advertisers, campaigns, insights, and catalogs. TikTok Ads is included in Pro: campaign status, catalog create/upload/bind, and Events API tracking. App access approval may still be pending. Nothing goes live until you approve it.

### Merchant Center, Google Business Profile, Shopify

Plugin-direct to Google or Shopify, not stamp. Merchant Center (Pro): read accounts, products, statuses, issues, data sources; confirm-gated product-input writes (create a data source, upsert or delete product inputs). GBP: read in this version; edit is not. Shopify (free): shop details, products, orders, locations, inventory, publications, catalogs, product feeds; inventory adjust and product set after you confirm.

### Klaviyo (free, local)

Account, profiles (sparse), lists, segments, flows, campaigns, metrics, catalog items/categories/variants, reviews. Confirm-gated edits: draft email campaign create; send an existing draft (explicit send confirmation); upsert profile; create event (backfill); upsert catalog items (capped). Merchant-held private API key stays on the user’s machine. Free. Not Pro. Not stamp. Never paste the key into chat. Creating a draft does not send it.

## Stamp API (public surface)

Pro advertising platforms are unlocked through the local plugin after a Pro license. That path is not published as a public OpenAPI or developer REST catalog on this site.

Machine-readable detail: /agent.json and /?mode=agent. API notes: /api/llms.txt.

## Agent discovery on this site

- /llms.txt — short navigation index
- /llms-full.txt — this file
- /docs/llms.txt — docs-oriented summary
- /api/llms.txt — stamp and auth surface
- /agent.json and /?mode=agent — structured JSON
- Companion .md via Accept: text/markdown
- /sitemap.xml, /robots.txt, /about, /contact, /privacy, /terms

## Company

DGTL Sunrise is an AI-first marketing engineer agency. Sunrise Consulting LLC ships dgtl-connector. Based in Coeur d’Alene, Idaho. We are not a managed-agency replacement. The plugin pulls, analyzes, and recommends. A human still publishes.

## How to use it

1. Install the plugin in your agent host.
2. Connect the account that owns the property, site, or ad account you care about.
3. Ask in chat. Name the property, site, or account when you have more than one.
4. Review and approve before anything is published or changed on your accounts.

### Start with a map

Before you ask for numbers, ask the Bot to list what it can see: GA4 properties, Search Console sites, GTM accounts, or ad accounts. Then pick the one you mean in plain language. If you leave it vague, a careful Bot will ask which one. Do not let it guess among agency or client accounts.

### Starter prompt

Paste this so the Bot knows you installed `dgtl-connector`, even if you come back weeks later. It should use those tools only, and it should not guess which account you mean.

```
I installed the dgtl-connector plugin (DGTL Sunrise). Connect Google if it is not connected yet. Using dgtl-connector tools only, list every marketing account the plugin can see: GA4 properties, Search Console sites, Tag Manager accounts and containers, plus Shopify, Klaviyo, or ad accounts if those are connected. Do not guess or pick a default. Summarize what is connected, what looks healthy, and the top three questions I should ask next. Keep it short. Do not change anything live.
```

### Ask for decisions, not dumps

Short, specific asks beat vague ones. Prefer a date range, a comparison, and the decision you need. Examples that work well:

- Compare last 28 days to the prior 28 for sessions, conversions, and top landing pages on property X.
- Which Search Console queries gained impressions but lost clicks this month on site Y?
- Show the live GTM tags on container Z and flag anything that still fires on thank-you without a conversion.
- Draft a keyword pause list for campaign C where cost is high and conversions are zero for 14 days. Do not push live until I approve.

If the Bot invents a metric or a property id, stop it and ask it to re-run from the connected account. Real tools beat remembered numbers.

### Confirm before live changes

When you Connect Google for Free features, you grant all Free Google permissions in that one Connect. The plugin expects those permissions before Free Google tools are useful. Live changes still need your confirmation. Treat chat as a draft surface: approve publishes, pauses, budget moves, and catalog edits the same way you would approve a pull request.

### Free first, Pro when you need ads

Use Free Google Analytics 4, Search Console, and Tag Manager on your machine with no DGTL account. Add Pro when you need Google Ads, Meta, or TikTok through the hosted gateway, or Merchant Center on the Pro path.

When you need those Pro paths, ask the Bot in plain language. Examples that work: "Upgrade me to DGTL Pro" or "I need Google Ads through dgtl-connector". The Bot should walk Polar checkout at $19 / month, then redeem the license on your install. Do not paste a license token into chat. After Pro is on the install, Connect Ads or Meta as needed.

Polar checkout: https://buy.polar.sh/polar_cl_yZECJ26Ln9mGTQDwBETXCskJRMTwrYAd6thMJO1zHPk

Homepage: https://www.dgtlsunrise.com/

Keep tokens and license keys out of chat. Put them only where the install expects them.

Never paste access tokens, refresh tokens, or license keys into chat.
